name: Constant-Time & Software Side-Channel Review
description: Covers review of cryptographic software for secret-dependent timing, branches and memory access patterns. Includes manual review techniques, use of constant-time verification tooling (dynamic analysis, statistical timing tests, formal and symbolic checkers), awareness of cache-timing and microarchitectural leakage, and reporting of findings with exploitability context. Physical timing and power measurement of devices belongs to HWSEC-SCA-TIMING.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to constant-time code review

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands software timing side channels and the constant-time programming discipline
evidence: Can explain how secret-dependent branches, table lookups and variable-time instructions leak information
Aware of cache-timing attacks against table-based AES and timing attacks against modular exponentiation
Understands why compiler optimisation can break source-level constant-time guarantees

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Reviews cryptographic code for obvious timing leaks under supervision
evidence: Identifies secret-dependent branches and memory indexing in a provided code sample
Runs constant-time analysis tooling on a library function and records the results with guidance
Identifies non-constant-time comparisons of MACs or authentication tags
Documents findings in the lab's reporting template

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently reviews cryptographic implementations for software side-channel weaknesses
evidence: Reviews symmetric and public-key implementations for secret-dependent control flow and memory access
Selects and applies appropriate verification tooling and interprets its findings and false positives
Inspects compiled output to confirm constant-time properties survive compilation
Rates findings with consideration of attacker position (remote, co-resident, local) and exploitability

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Assesses complex implementations and microarchitectural exposure; reviews work; mentors team
evidence: Evaluates implementations against microarchitectural leakage (speculative execution, cache and port contention)
Assesses masking or blinding countermeasures in software and their limitations
Technically reviews constant-time review reports for completeness and accuracy
Mentors analysts on constant-time review techniques and tooling

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Recognised authority on software side channels; defines methodology; publishes research
evidence: Defines the lab's constant-time review methodology and tooling baseline
Publishes research on software side-channel attacks or verification techniques
Advises library maintainers and vendors on constant-time implementation
Evaluates new verification tools for adoption by the lab

assessment_methods.description: Review the constant-time review report for a cryptographic library function, checking coverage of branches, memory access and compiled output, and the justification of severity ratings
Given source code and compiled binaries of several cryptographic routines with seeded timing leaks, identify each leak, demonstrate it with appropriate tooling, and propose a constant-time fix
